title: DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, January 31, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, January 31, 2018 Posted by admin on January 31st, 2018 
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Travelers (TRV). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +212 points. 
Tuesday the Dow was down -362.59 (-1.37%) at 26,076.89. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.49%. 
There were 5 Dow stocks up Tuesday. 
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Caterpillar (CAT) +0.73% and Procter & Gamble (PG) +0.10%. Funny, Caterpillar (CAT) was the leading down Dow stock yesterday. 
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by UnitedHealth (UNH) -4.35% and Pfizer (PFE) -3.13%. 
Boeing (BA) crushes earnings this morning and jumps 6%. See earnings section below. 
Apple (AAPL -0.59%) is down almost 1% in pre-market trading after it was downgraded to ‘Market Perform’ from ‘Outperform’ at BMO Capital Markets. 
Private companies hired another 234,000 in January, well above expectations for 185,000, according to ADP and Moody’s Analytics. 
The Fed winds up their meeting today about 11:00 am PST. 
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower. 
The national average price of gasoline is up five-tenths of a cent at $2.591 per gallon.
